purpose: Make every birth year in the 2,000-calendar-year window and every broad world region selectable. Region weights are game-balance weights, not population shares.

birth_year_window.rule: Select each calendar year with equal base probability unless a reviewed scenario data version supplies a documented alternative. This window advances with the reference year so it always contains 2,000 calendar-year labels ending at the reference year.

sampling_order: sample birth_year from the rolling 2,000-year window
sample macro_region using the authored game-balance weights
sample a place and community within the region using empirical or clearly labeled estimated weights
sample household and initial circumstances conditional on birth year and place
weight_policy: Equal region weights are a transparent game design choice to keep each region present. They are not historically accurate population or birth shares. The player can see the sampled scope and the estimate label.

southeast_asia.coverage_tier: generic_estimated_scene; add named place only after local authoring review

west_and_central_asia_north_africa.coverage_tier: generic_estimated_scene; add named place only after local authoring review

americas.coverage_tier: generic_estimated_scene; add named place only after local authoring review

oceania.coverage_tier: generic_estimated_scene; add named place only after local authoring review

timeline_policy: Birth selection uses a continuous calendar year. Context data may be stored in ranges for source management, but a range edge does not itself cause a life-stage transition or scripted event. Each quarter resolves the context valid for the current location and year; person state and relationships persist across context updates.
data_gap_policy: Where no empirical or local historical data exists, use a coherent game estimate with low/central/high sensitivity values and a visible estimate label. Do not represent a generic regional estimate as a specific city or people's measured history.
prototype_note: The five historical-source and five present-day deep-dive anchors are the first richly authored places. Other years and broad regions remain selectable through clearly labeled generic estimated scenes; they do not claim a measured city, population, or local custom.
settlement_profile_policy: Initial authoring weights for regions and years without local place data. These are broad fictional scene profiles, not a claim about historical settlement shares. A real named city is used only when a corresponding deep-dive context exists; otherwise the screen labels the location as a regional game estimate.

player_facing_labels.birth_estimate: ゲーム用推定の出生舞台

region_labels.west_and_central_asia_north_africa: 西・中央アジア／北アフリカ

mortality_coverage.1950_to_2100: Use WPP 2024 country series for the five deep-dive country anchors; other locations use a labeled regional game estimate until a local series is authored. WPP 2024-2100 values remain projection-series values even when a year has passed the current calendar year.
mortality_coverage.27_to_1949: Use low/central/high age-specific game estimates, with rural or urban/trade life-pattern profile chosen from the generated setting. These estimates are not historical population measurements.
mortality_coverage.after_2100: Continue with an explicitly labeled game hypothesis based on the terminal estimate; do not display as a published forecast.

household_archetype_policy: Use only after sampling a settlement profile, as provisional conditional story weights. Each category is deliberately broad and is not a historically attested social class. Add local categories when an authored deep-dive context supports them; preserve an other_household category.
context_resolution_order: exact local-place and calendar-year record within the deep-dive context validity window
authored successor-context record for the current place and year
regional calendar-year-range record with evidence tier and uncertainty
generic region and settlement-profile game estimate
context_update_policy: Resolve the best available record at each calendar year and quarter. Switching records changes applicable social-condition and event-generation parameters only; do not create a scripted age transition, reset character state, or automatically trigger an event at a range boundary.
